    <!-- Auto-close navbar when clicking outside script -->
    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Close any open navbar when clicking outside of it
        document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
            // Handle all instances of navbar collapse elements
            const navbarCollapses = document.querySelectorAll('.navbar-collapse');
            const navbarTogglers = document.querySelectorAll('.navbar-toggler');
            
            // Process each navbar collapse
            navbarCollapses.forEach(function(collapse) {
                // Skip if this collapse isn't showing
                if (!collapse.classList.contains('show')) return;
                
                // Find the toggler for this specific collapse
                let matchingToggler = null;
                navbarTogglers.forEach(function(toggler) {
                    const targetId = toggler.getAttribute('data-bs-target');
                    if (targetId && targetId === '#' + collapse.id) {
                        matchingToggler = toggler;
                    }
                });
                
                // If no matching toggler found, use any available toggler
                if (!matchingToggler && navbarTogglers.length > 0) {
                    matchingToggler = navbarTogglers[0];
                }
                
                // Check if the click was outside both the navbar collapse and toggler
                let clickedOutside = true;
                
                // Check if clicked inside the collapse
                if (collapse.contains(event.target)) {
                    clickedOutside = false;
                }
                
                // Check if clicked on the toggler
                if (matchingToggler && matchingToggler.contains(event.target)) {
                    clickedOutside = false;
                }
                
                // If clicked outside, close the navbar
                if (clickedOutside) {
                    // Try to use Bootstrap's Collapse API
                    if (typeof bootstrap !== 'undefined') {
                        try {
                            const bsCollapse = bootstrap.Collapse.getInstance(collapse);
                            if (bsCollapse) {
                                bsCollapse.hide();
                            } else {
                                // If no instance exists, create one and hide it
                                new bootstrap.Collapse(collapse, { toggle: false }).hide();
                            }
                        } catch(e) {
                            // Fallback if Bootstrap API fails
                            collapse.classList.remove('show');
                            if (matchingToggler) {
                                matchingToggler.classList.add('collapsed');
                                matchingToggler.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Fallback if Bootstrap JS API isn't available
                        collapse.classList.remove('show');
                        if (matchingToggler) {
                            matchingToggler.classList.add('collapsed');
                            matchingToggler.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    });
    </script>

        updateNavButtonsState(event.relatedTarget);
      },
      onResized: function (event) {
        updateNavButtonsState(event.relatedTarget);
      }
    });

    function updateContent(tabElement) {
      const tabText = $(tabElement).text().trim();
      const contentId = tabText.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-') + '-content';

      $('.service-tab-item').removeClass('active');
      $(tabElement).addClass('active');
      $('.service-content').removeClass('active-content').hide();

      if (tabText === '3PL') {
        $('#3pl-content').addClass('active-content').show();
      } else {
        $('#' + contentId).addClass('active-content').show();
      }
    }

    $('.service-tab-item').on('click', function () {
      updateContent(this);
    });

    serviceTabsCarousel.on('changed.owl.carousel', function (event) {
      const carousel = event.relatedTarget;
      const currentIndex = carousel.relative(carousel.current());

      // Only target non-cloned original items
      const currentTab = $('.service-tab-item').not('.cloned').eq(currentIndex);
      if (currentTab.length) {
        updateContent(currentTab);
      }

      // Update nav buttons active/inactive states
      updateNavButtonsState(carousel);
    });

    // Function to update nav buttons state based on carousel position
    function updateNavButtonsState(carousel) {
      // Check if at the beginning
      if (carousel.current() <= 0) {
        $('.service-tabs-carousel .owl-prev').addClass('disabled');
      } else {
        $('.service-tabs-carousel .owl-prev').removeClass('disabled');
      }

      // Check if at the end (accounting for visible items)
      const lastVisible = carousel.items().length - carousel.settings.items;
      if (carousel.current() >= lastVisible) {
        $('.service-tabs-carousel .owl-next').addClass('disabled');
      } else {
        $('.service-tabs-carousel .owl-next').removeClass('disabled');
      }
    }

    // Initial check for nav buttons state
    setTimeout(function () {
      const carousel = $('.service-tabs-carousel').data('owl.carousel');
      if (carousel) {
        updateNavButtonsState(carousel);
      }
    }, 100);
  });
</script>

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');

    // Check if elements exist before proceeding
    if (!slides.length || !prevBtn || !nextBtn) {
      console.error('Carousel elements not found. Slides with content:', slides.length);
      return;
    }

    let currentSlide = 0;
    let autoPlayInterval = null;
    const totalSlides = slides.length;
    const autoPlayDelay = 600000; // 5 seconds for auto-play delay
    let autoPlayRunning = false; // Track whether auto-play is running

    console.log('Total slides found:', totalSlides);

    // Function to show specific slide
    function showSlide(index) {
      // Ensure index is within bounds
      if (index < 0 || index >= totalSlides) {
        console.error('Invalid slide index:', index, 'Total slides:', totalSlides);
        return;
      }

      console.log('Showing slide:', index, 'of', totalSlides);

      // Hide all slides
      slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
        slide.classList.remove('active');
      });

      // Add active class to current slide
      if (slides[index]) {
        slides[index].classList.add('active');
        console.log('Active class added to slide:', index);
      } else {
        console.error('Slide not found at index:', index);
      }

      // Disable "Prev" button on the first slide
      if (index === 0) {
        prevBtn.disabled = true;  // Disable the "Prev" button on the first slide
      } else {
        prevBtn.disabled = false;  // Re-enable the "Prev" button when not on the first slide
      }

      // Disable "Next" button on the last slide
      if (index === totalSlides - 1) {
        nextBtn.disabled = true;  // Disable the "Next" button on the last slide
        stopAutoPlay(); // Stop auto-play when on the last slide
      } else {
        nextBtn.disabled = false;  // Re-enable the "Next" button when not on the last slide
      }

      // Update bottom indicators
      updateIndicators(index);
    }

    // Function to update bottom indicators
    function updateIndicators(slideIndex) {
      const currentSlideElement = slides[slideIndex];
      const indicators = currentSlideElement.querySelectorAll('.card-bottom-indicator');

      // Reset all indicators in current slide
      indicators.forEach(indicator => {
        indicator.classList.remove('active');
      });

      // Activate the second card's indicator (as shown in the design)
      if (indicators.length > 1) {
        indicators[1].classList.add('active');
      }
    }

    // Next slide function with looping
    function nextSlide() {
      currentSlide = (currentSlide + 1) % totalSlides;
      console.log('Next slide - moving to:', currentSlide);
      showSlide(currentSlide);
    }

    // Previous slide function with looping
    function prevSlide() {
      currentSlide = (currentSlide - 1 + totalSlides) % totalSlides;
      console.log('Previous slide - moving to:', currentSlide);
      showSlide(currentSlide);
    }

    // Auto-play functionality with looping
    function startAutoPlay() {
      if (autoPlayRunning) return;  // If auto-play is already running, do nothing
      stopAutoPlay(); // Clear any existing interval
      autoPlayInterval = setInterval(function () {
        nextSlide(); // nextSlide() now handles looping automatically
      }, autoPlayDelay);
      autoPlayRunning = true;  // Mark auto-play as running
    }

    function stopAutoPlay() {
      if (autoPlayInterval) {
        clearInterval(autoPlayInterval);
        autoPlayInterval = null;
        autoPlayRunning = false;  // Mark auto-play as stopped
      }
      console.log('Auto-play stopped');
    }

    // Event listeners for navigation buttons
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      console.log('Next button clicked');
      nextSlide();
      stopAutoPlay(); // Stop auto-play when user interacts
    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      console.log('Previous button clicked');
      prevSlide();
      stopAutoPlay(); // Stop auto-play when user interacts
    });

    // Keyboard navigation
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        prevSlide();
        stopAutoPlay();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        nextSlide();
        stopAutoPlay();
      }
    });

    // Pause auto-play on hover
    const carouselWrapper = document.querySelector('.industry-carousel-wrapper');
    if (carouselWrapper) {
      carouselWrapper.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoPlay);
      carouselWrapper.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoPlay);
    }

    // Touch/swipe support for mobile
    let startX = 0;
    let endX = 0;

    if (carouselWrapper) {
      carouselWrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
        startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      });

      carouselWrapper.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
        endX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
        handleSwipe();
      });
    }

    function handleSwipe() {
      const swipeThreshold = 50;
      const diff = startX - endX;

      if (Math.abs(diff) > swipeThreshold) {
        if (diff > 0) {
          // Swipe left - next slide
          nextSlide();
        } else {
          // Swipe right - previous slide
          prevSlide();
        }
        stopAutoPlay(); // Stop auto-play on swipe
      }
    }

    // Initialize carousel
    console.log('Initializing carousel');
    showSlide(currentSlide);
    startAutoPlay(); // Start auto-play initially
  });
</script>

<script>// Make ScrollTrigger available for use in GSAP animations
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  // Select the HTML elements needed for the animation
  const scrollSection = document.querySelectorAll(".scroll-vertical");

  scrollSection.forEach((section) => {
    const scrollSectionInner = section.querySelector(".scroll-section");
    const wrapper = section.querySelector(".wrapper");
    const items = wrapper.querySelectorAll(".item");

    // Initialize
    let direction = null;

    if (scrollSectionInner && scrollSectionInner.classList.contains("vertical-section")) {
      direction = "vertical";
    } else if (scrollSectionInner && scrollSectionInner.classList.contains("horizontal-section")) {
      direction = "horizontal";
    } else {
      // Default to vertical for scroll-vertical sections
      direction = "vertical";
    }

    initScroll(section, items, direction);
  });

  function initScroll(section, items, direction) {
    // Initial states
    items.forEach((item, index) => {
      // Set initial position for item containers (except the first)
      if (index !== 0) {
        direction == "horizontal"
          ? gsap.set(item, { xPercent: 100 })
          : gsap.set(item, { yPercent: 100 });
      } else {
        // Ensure first item is fully visible with correct positioning
        gsap.set(item, {
          xPercent: 0,
          yPercent: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          scale: 1,
          borderRadius: "10px"
        });
      }

      // Set initial opacity for all item content elements
      const content = item.querySelector('.item_content');
      if (content) {
        // Only the first item's content should be visible initially
        gsap.set(content, { opacity: index === 0 ? 1 : 0 });
      }

      // Make sure the media is visible for the first slide
      const media = item.querySelector('.item-media');
      if (media && index === 0) {
        gsap.set(media, { opacity: 1 });
      }
    });

    // Track current active content
    let currentIndex = 0;
    let previousIndex = -1;

    // Create separate timeline for content animations
    const contentTimeline = gsap.timeline();

    const timeline = gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: section,
        pin: true,
        start: "top top",
        end: () => `+=${items.length * 100}%`,
        scrub: 0.5, // Faster scrub for better responsiveness
        anticipatePin: 1, // Helps with smoother pin transitions
        fastScrollEnd: true, // Improves behavior on fast scrolling
        preventOverlaps: true, // Prevents animation overlap issues
        invalidateOnRefresh: true,
        onUpdate: (self) => {
          // Calculate precise scroll progress
          const totalItems = items.length;
          const normalizedProgress = self.progress * totalItems; // 0 to totalItems range
          const currentItemIndex = Math.min(Math.floor(normalizedProgress), totalItems - 1);
          const nextItemIndex = Math.min(currentItemIndex + 1, totalItems - 1);

          // Calculate progress within the current item (0 to 1)
          const progressWithinItem = normalizedProgress - currentItemIndex;

          // Track fast scrolling by measuring velocity
          const velocity = Math.abs(self.getVelocity() / 1000);
          const isFastScroll = velocity > 5; // Threshold for fast scrolling

          // Reset all content visibility first to handle fast scrolling
          if (isFastScroll) {
            items.forEach((item, index) => {
              const content = item.querySelector('.item_content');
              if (!content) return;

              // During fast scrolling, respect our 80% threshold rule
              if (index === currentItemIndex) {
                // Hide current content immediately
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.set(content, { opacity: progressWithinItem < 0.5 ? 1 : 0 });
              } else if (index === nextItemIndex && progressWithinItem >= 0.8) {
                // Show next content only if we've crossed 80% threshold
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.set(content, { opacity: 1 });
              } else {
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.set(content, { opacity: 0 });
              }
            });
            return; // Skip the regular animation during fast scrolling
          }

          // Handle opacity transitions for all items during normal scrolling
          items.forEach((item, index) => {
            const content = item.querySelector('.item_content');
            if (!content) return;

            // Special case for the last item to ensure it's always visible when active
            if (index === totalItems - 1 && currentItemIndex === totalItems - 1) {
              gsap.killTweensOf(content);
              gsap.to(content, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3 });
              return;
            }

            if (index === currentItemIndex) {
              // Current item's content - start fading out as soon as we begin scrolling
              if (progressWithinItem > 0) {
                // Fade out current content more quickly to ensure it's gone before next appears
                const opacity = 1 - (progressWithinItem * 2); // Faster fade out (0-50% scroll)
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.to(content, {
                  opacity: Math.max(0, opacity),
                  duration: 0.2, // Faster duration
                  ease: "power2.out"
                });
              } else {
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.set(content, { opacity: 1 });
              }
            }
            else if (index === nextItemIndex && nextItemIndex < items.length) {
              // Next item's content - only start appearing AFTER 80% scroll point
              if (progressWithinItem >= 0.8) {
                // Fade in from 0% to 100% after the 80% point
                // Map 0.8-1.0 progress range to 0-1 opacity
                const opacity = (progressWithinItem - 0.8) / 0.2;
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.to(content, {
                  opacity: Math.min(1, opacity),
                  duration: 0.2,
                  ease: "power1.in"
                });
              } else {
                gsap.killTweensOf(content);
                gsap.set(content, { opacity: 0 });
              }
            }
            else {
              // All other items should have zero opacity
              gsap.killTweensOf(content);
              gsap.set(content, { opacity: 0 });
            }
          });
        }
      },
      defaults: { ease: "none" }
    });

    items.forEach((item, index) => {
      timeline.to(item, {
        scale: 1,
        borderRadius: "10px",
        overwrite: "auto" // Prevents animation conflicts during fast scrolling
      });

      // Only animate the next item if it exists
      if (index + 1 < items.length) {
        direction == "horizontal"
          ? timeline.to(
            items[index + 1],
            {
              xPercent: 0,
              overwrite: "auto" // Prevents animation conflicts
            },
            "<"
          )
          : timeline.to(
            items[index + 1],
            {
              yPercent: 0,
              overwrite: "auto" // Prevents animation conflicts
            },
            "<"
          );
      }

      // Special handling for the last item to ensure it stays in position
      if (index === items.length - 2) {
        timeline.add(() => {
          // Ensure last item is properly positioned
          const lastItem = items[items.length - 1];
          gsap.set(lastItem, {
            scale: 1,
            borderRadius: "10px",
            xPercent: direction === "horizontal" ? 0 : undefined,
            yPercent: direction === "vertical" ? 0 : undefined
          });
        });
      }
    });
  }</script>

<script>
  // Counter animation for stats section
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const counterElements = document.querySelectorAll('.counter-element');

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !entry.target.classList.contains('counted')) {
          entry.target.classList.add('counted');

          const countTo = parseInt(entry.target.getAttribute('data-count'));
          const suffix = entry.target.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
          const countDuration = 2000;
          const startTime = Date.now();

          // ✅ Function to format number in Indian numbering format
          function formatIndianNumber(num) {
            return num.toLocaleString('en-IN');
          }

          function easeOutQuad(t) {
            return t * (2 - t);
          }

          function updateCounter() {
            const now = Date.now();
            const progress = Math.min(1, (now - startTime) / countDuration);
            const easedProgress = easeOutQuad(progress);
            const currentCount = Math.floor(countTo * easedProgress);

            // ✅ Format number in Indian style
            entry.target.textContent = formatIndianNumber(currentCount) + suffix;

            if (progress < 1) {
              requestAnimationFrame(updateCounter);
            } else {
              // Final exact value
              entry.target.textContent = formatIndianNumber(countTo) + suffix;
            }
          }

          updateCounter();
        }
      });
    }, {
      threshold: 0.1,
      rootMargin: '0px'
    });

    counterElements.forEach(element => {
      observer.observe(element);
    });
  });
</script>
